title: BranchStateData
description: A branch ref update or authoritative checkpoint for a branch-owned git state log.

refName.description: Full branch ref name this state applies to

oldTarget.description: Expected previous commit target for ref updates

newTarget.description: New commit target for ref updates; null represents deletion

target.description: Authoritative target for checkpoints; null represents deletion

actorDid.description: DID that produced this state record

bundleRecordId.description: Optional associated branch bundle record ID

force.description: Whether this update represents a non-fast-forward git push

acceptedStateRecordId.description: Latest accepted delta included in a checkpoint

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when a checkpoint was accepted

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this state record was created
